Pick up where I was
How this works
There is more to a problem than its answer: what kind of thing it is, what it asks for, which move applies, and what would confirm it.
Most of that stays in your head, so it is hard to tell which parts you really rely on.
So at each step you select what you actually used or noticed.
Then you see which of them hold up, which stop short, and the one the step really turns on.
What you keep becomes your notes. Across problems, a pattern shows up: the parts you lean on, and the parts you skip.
